notes.title: New Features: Locomotion Options, Easy Mode, Bonus Location, Many fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

We have another cool update for you! Few new features have been added and fixed (previously in beta):

- [b]New Feature[/b]: [b]Easy Mode[/b] - New difficulty mode selector is placed right outside the settings tent. You start with 50% more health, zombies are 30% slower and give you double the score on death. You also have 50% more time before needing the pills. This creates a lot more casual experience for those who want to enjoy the scenery a bit more ;) To make things fair, only third of your score and cash is counted towards weapon unlocks and leader boards. Level unlocks stay unchanged.
- [b]New Feature[/b]: You are Denied Survival no more! You have a choice! As soon as you earn 30k points, portal comes on, to take you to the next level. You can cross at any time after it opens. This portal takes you to a brand new location, where you will be granted bonus perks, to give you a head start in the next level! there is a perk at 30k and then one for each threshold: 50k, 80k, 120k, 170k. From there you will be able to travel to the next map. There is no portal on the last map, yet ;)
- Further [b]performance improvements[/b], as we have now transitioned to Single Pass Instanced stereo rendering mode.
- Added [b]Smooth Turn[/b], interface for adjustment is temporary, but functional.
- Fixed jittery hands issue.
- Improved pathfinding performance.
- Fixed zombies getting stuck on a fence on Singularity map.
- First round of audio tweaks, weapons and explosions should sound a bit better.
- Selected graphics quality level, is now highlighted in green (in the settings tent).
- Added player spawn effect.
- Fixed muzzle flash effect, it no longer appears to drift away from the weapon.
- Improved behaviour of laser rifle projectiles.
- Updated WMR controller bindings.
- Fixed sound issues with Grenade and guided missile launchers.
- Nuke and level-up explosions no longer destroy nearby barrels.
- Added more variety to explosion sounds.
- Various bug fixes.

Game guide has been updated to reflect the above changes:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/bpistdj47gr4cvp/How_to_play_Survival_Denied_guide.pdf?dl=0


Keep your eyes open for more updates! Next one will be big!

- Zed out!

notes.title: New perk, visual updates, haptic feedback for interactions and more!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today's update brings the following: 

- Reduced screen darkening when taking damage.
- Added choice between controller and HMD movement direction (new icon near settings tent).
- Added haptic feedback to most common interactions (selecting settings, levels, weapons).
- Added new perk - second chance - grants second life upon death, also kills enemies nearby. It's a game changer!
- Unstoppable achievement is now achievable!
- Zombies are now slightly slower to in the beginning of the game.
- New model and effects for pulse/freeze gun (almost total rework).
- Charge/reload indicator on energy weapons.
- RPG now shows a rocket inside the barrel when ready.
- Removed part of the bridge on City map to help with navigation.
- Blocked mountains area in the first (Forest) map, to prevent players from going out of the map/zombie range.
- Increased damage of Laser Rifle.
- Various small improvements and fixes.

As always, keep your eyes open for more updates!

- Zed out!

notes.title: First update - Tutorial
notes.notes:

More updates coming soon!
